name: marketnow-install-stack
description: One-command curated skill-stack installs for Claude Desktop, Cursor and Cline. Resolves stacks against the LIVE MarketNow catalog (9,000+ MCP skills; /api/skills?category=...&filter=free) with an embedded offline fallback, follows HTTP redirects, honors each skill's real install command (npx / uvx), merges into your existing agent config with automatic backup, and supports --help / --list. Stacks: financial-auditor (Finance), security-analyst (Security), data-pipeline (Data), dev-productivity (Developer Tools), growth-hacking (AI/ML). v1.2.0 reliability release — fixes the broken apex-domain fetch and the removed /api/stacks endpoint from v1.1.x.
